puzzleText:
To help you on your mission, the Quartermaster has given you a state-of-the art new spy-bike.

It will help you to get around the city quickly and easily.

It has all the latest tech:
  - lithium-ion batteries
  - pedal-assist
  - and smartphone integration.

Q has left your bike chained up in the bike rack at the front lobby.

The combination to unlock it is a 4-digit number.

Solve this number square to get the combination and unlock your new bike:[[ASCII]]

			-----------------
			| 8 | 4 | 6 | 2 |
			-----------------
			| 2 | 6 | 4 | 8 |
			-----------------
			| 4 | 2 | 8 | 6 |
			-----------------
			|   |   |   |   |
			-----------------
[[/ASCII]]
hint: Each digit must appear only once in each column and each row.
title: A Present From Q
